name: Omnisend
line: Ecommerce email campaigns and customer journeys across channels.

free.text: Free for 250 contacts and 500 emails/month; also 500 web pushes

cells.api: Yes, API can trigger workflows; features vary by plan

subs.math: 4,000 newsletter emails. The Standard reference allows 12,000 sends.
20,000 emails to 5,000 subscribers. The reference allowance is 60,000 sends.
40,000 emails to 10,000 subscribers. The reference allowance is 120,000 sends.
Official references for 50,000 subscribers disagree. The 600,000-send allowance covers the 200,000-email workload.

appmail.math: 500 billable profiles × 6 single-email runs = 3,000 emails. The quota is 6,000, spread at 100 a day over a 30-day cycle.
1,000 billable profiles × 10 single-email runs = 10,000 emails. The quota is 12,000, spread at 334 a day over a 30-day cycle.
5,000 billable profiles × 10 single-email runs = 50,000 emails. The quota is 60,000, spread at 1,667 a day over a 30-day cycle.
10,000 billable profiles × 10 single-email runs = 100,000 emails. The quota is 120,000, spread at 3,334 a day over a 30-day cycle.
